rationale: Behaviour versus stated rule, and it bears directly on trade management. This source states the take-profit is set to 'a minimum of a 1 to two risk to reward', which makes 1:2 an acceptable target. Source #8 (CLAIM|ALEX_G|20260728|145) names closing a trade that was set to 1:4 AT 1:2 as the core psychological failure - 'the exit is driven by the size of the number, not by the market'. Both cannot be applied without a rule distinguishing a target SET at the 1:2 floor from a target REVISED down to it. The distinction is never drawn in either source, and it determines whether a preset target may be reduced after entry.
